paper_citation: Ru, B. et al. Estimation of cell lineages in tumors from spatial transcriptomics data. Nat Commun 14, 1074 (2023).
notes: Gold claims are scorer-only. Agents must never see this file.

claims.statement: Tumor ST spots are mixtures of malignant and non-malignant lineages; accurate local cell-density–aware deconvolution reveals spatially structured immune and stromal fractions.
At the tumor–immune interface, intercellular interactions (cell colocalization plus ligand–receptor co-expression) promote cancer progression programs.

CAF–M2 macrophage colocalized spots show stronger ligand–receptor network activity than CAF- or M2-dominated spots, supporting a CAF–M2 interaction axis (distinct from CAF–endothelial colocalization).
